families.title: Feasibility studies & project preparation
families.definition: Feasibility studies and project preparation that give an approving body what it needs to decide: technical, financial, economic, social and market feasibility, costed implementation and financing plans, and results frameworks — in the approving institution’s own format.
deliverables: Feasibility report — technical, financial, economic, social and market — in the approver’s format
Capital and recurrent cost estimates and a phased financing plan
Investment concept notes and screening templates
Donor-ready proposal material: economic justification, projections, risks, implementation and financing plans
standards: Planning Division / Planning Commission feasibility format

families.title: Cost-benefit & financial analysis
families.definition: Economic and financial appraisal that tells a funder whether a project is worth its cost — ENPV, EIRR, FNPV, FIRR, benefit-cost ratios and switching values, costed and financed, and built to the approving institution’s guidelines.
deliverables: Economic and financial model with sensitivity and switching values
Economic and financial analysis chapter for the feasibility report
Capital, recurrent and O&M cost estimates with a financing plan
families.note: Environmental and social benefits have been part of earlier appraisals — an economic and social cost-benefit analysis for a new township, and benefit analysis for off-grid energy and municipal infrastructure. Valuation methods are agreed for each assignment.

families.title: Policy research & advocacy — Bangladesh & international
families.definition: Policy research for Bangladesh and the region that is designed to be used: survey and qualitative evidence, gap and constraint analysis, policy briefs, and structured dialogue with the people who decide.
deliverables: Survey, KII and FGD instruments and datasets

families.title: Management consulting, M&E & evaluation
families.definition: Management consulting for public programmes and institutions: results frameworks and measurement systems, impact evaluations including randomised trials, and the governance, financing and investment plans that let an institution deliver.
deliverables: Results framework and results-based measurement tools
Governance reform, financing and investment plans

families.title: Data stories & decision technology
families.definition: Data and technology put to work on a decision: firm and household surveys, policy databases and indices, appraisal of digital and AI programmes, GIS-informed pipelines — and reports that turn the data into a story someone can act on.
deliverables: Firm and household survey instruments and datasets
Feasibility of digital and AI-powered programmes
Policy reports built on survey data

nsep-56088.summary: ENPV and FNPV, EIRR and FIRR and benefit-cost ratios with scenario-based sensitivity, built as Excel models and narratives for Planning Commission-format feasibility reports.

jolshiri.short: Testing the case for a new city.

bmdf-green-municipal.summary: Viability, cost-benefit analysis and a ten-year financial roadmap for municipal renewable energy, street lighting and waste-to-energy, with GIS-informed investment pipelines.

green-trade-reform.summary: Scoping, stakeholder and institutional mapping and policy-gap analysis on trade, investment and finance for environmental goods and services, contributing to the World Bank’s Bangladesh trade and climate report.

unctad-pcga.summary: A Productive Capacities Gap Assessment for Bangladesh with UNCTAD and CPD: productive capacities index analysis, binding constraints and policy recommendations for LDC graduation.

wto-services-trade.summary: Bangladesh entries for the World Bank–WTO Global Services Trade Policy Database and Index, compiled from regulatory desk research and interviews.

dscc-vision-2050.summary: Preparatory studies for Dhaka South City Corporation’s Vision 2050: a city financing and investment plan, a governance reform plan, and business and revenue models.

halow.short: Worker health, productivity and the business case.
halow.summary: M&E adviser and impact evaluation expert for the HALOW+ partnership: a randomised trial, health and productivity databases, cost-benefit and business value analysis.

dsip-dwasa.summary: An M&E and results framework for a five-year World Bank sanitation operation in Dhaka.

jica-beza-biffl.summary: Equity investment policy, special-purpose company formulation, shareholder and project agreements for BIFFL and BEZA, supporting the JICA team.

bicf-ifc.summary: Results measurement and evaluation for IFC’s Bangladesh Investment Climate Fund: RBM tools, business confidence surveys, and evaluation of 20 simplification and automation projects.

adb-fsi-reta.short: Making a banking system legible to its regulator.
adb-fsi-reta.summary: National consultant on ADB’s regional technical assistance for financial soundness indicators: balance-sheet data for 400 non-financial corporations and indicator guidelines for Bangladesh Bank and the Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics.

global-leap.short: Designing results-based finance for off-grid energy.
global-leap.summary: Results-based financing design for Global LEAP: viability-gap estimation, cost-recovery frameworks, cost-benefit analysis and a four-year M&E framework.

sarti-cargo.short: Counting the cost of cargo loss.
sarti-cargo.summary: A regional trade-logistics study for IFC using historical trader data (2007–2013) on cargo loss and damage across Bangladesh, India and Nepal.

tiga-bmgf.summary: Ex-ante impact assessment and farm-household segmentation for inclusive technology adoption, with baseline and endline surveys and RCT design support, for the Gates Foundation.

resa-electricity.summary: Economic and financial feasibility of electricity regulatory reforms in Bangladesh, India and Nepal: tariffs, cost recovery, subsidies and a comparative cost-benefit analysis.

tobacco-taxation.short: The economics of a tobacco tax.
tobacco-taxation.summary: Price-elasticity estimation, a tax-administration review and advocacy — roundtables, direct lobbying and media — for effective tobacco taxation.
